group.title: Swimming-pool schedule
group.passage:
Westside Pool — Thursday schedule

The main pool is reserved for school lessons from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m. Public swimming begins at 11:15 a.m. The smaller teaching pool remains closed until 1 p.m. for filter maintenance.

The family session runs from 2 to 4 p.m. During this session, children under twelve must be accompanied in the water by an adult. Lane swimming resumes at 4:15 p.m.

Tickets are sold at the entrance; advance booking is not required for public swimming. Swim caps are available for purchase, but towels are not provided. The café closes at 5 p.m., one hour before the pool building.
group.passageZh:
Westside 游泳池——星期四時程

主池上午九點至十一點保留給學校課程，十一點十五分開始開放一般游泳。較小的教學池因濾水設備維護，關閉至下午一點。

家庭時段為下午兩點至四點。這段時間，十二歲以下兒童須由成人在水中陪同。四點十五分恢復泳道游泳。

門口現場售票，一般游泳不需提前預約。現場可購買泳帽，但不提供毛巾。咖啡廳下午五點關閉，比泳池大樓早一小時。
